test_programs.policy: Apply the fixed patch to the developer-provided clint_Plic program, build it with the recorded command, and run the resulting AClint readback image.

comparison.pass_condition: Every selected program completes with zero RTL-versus-ISA trace mismatches.

fixed_test_patches.purpose: Adapt the upstream clint_Plic program to write and read back the AClint mtimecmp register using zero, one, and a value with nonzero upper 32 bits. Add the explicit Zicsr assembler extension required by the pinned toolchain.

comparison_configuration.reason: Map Dromajo's standard mtimecmp offset 0x4000 to the Rift2330 AClint mtimecmp address 0x20000 so both models execute the same register semantics.
